fullPassage: 'Free play' teaches an awareness of space and the confidence to move about in it, important skills that are fundamental to navigation and wayfinding. Research shows that children who are allowed to roam free have a better sense of their surroundings, and a better sense of direction. This may explain why people who grow up in rural areas tend to be better navigators than those who grow up in cities. One study found that nine-year-olds who regularly cycle around their home towns are able to sketch them in greater detail than those who don't. This suggests an advanced level of spatial cognition for their age. Others have shown that eleven-year-olds who make their own way to school can draw more accurate maps of their local area than their peers who are accompanied by an adult or travel by car. This is the difference between active and passive learning: children who are driven everywhere never get the opportunity to make their own decisions or draw their own maps. They cease being explorers.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장에서  share의 의미로 가장 적절한 것을 짝지은 것은?

(A) The graph shows the <u>shares</u> of renewable electricity generation by region.
(B) Please <u>share</u> this information with your team.

det.analysis:
✅ ② (A) 점유율 — (B) 공유하다: (A)에서 share는 명사로 '점유율, 비율', (B)에서 share는 동사로 '공유하다, 나누다'.
❌ ① (A) 주식 — (B) 분배하다: (A)는 통계 맥락이므로 '주식'이 아닌 '점유율'.
❌ ③ (A) 공유 — (B) 점유하다: (A)의 명사 의미가 반대.
❌ ④ (A) 몫 — (B) 투자하다: (B)는 '투자하다'가 아닌 '공유하다'.
det.tip: share — 명사: 점유율, 비율, 주식, 몫 / 동사: 공유하다, 나누다.

❌ ① distribution: '배전, 유통'은 생산이 아닌 전달 과정.
❌ ② consumption: '소비'는 생산의 반대.
❌ ④ transmission: '송전'은 에너지 전달.
det.tip: generation(발전, 생성) — electricity generation = 전력 생산. generate(동사: 생성하다).
